  "code": "def summarize_chip_yield(rows, required_items):
    chips = {}
    duplicates_ignored = 0
    missing_values = 0

    for row in rows:
        chip_id = row["chip_id"]
        test_item = row["test_item"]
        value = row["value"]
        unit = row["unit"]
        lower = row["lower"]
        upper = row["upper"]
        retest = row["retest"]

        if unit not in ["V", "mV"]:
            raise ValueError(f'Invalid unit: {unit}')

        if unit == "mV":
            value = float(value) / 1000
            lower = float(lower) / 1000
            upper = float(upper) / 1000

        try:
            value = float(value)
            lower = float(lower)
            upper = float(upper)
            retest = int(retest)
        except ValueError:
            missing_values += 1
            continue

        if value == "":
            missing_values += 1
            continue

        if (chip_id, test_item, retest) in chips:
            duplicates_ignored += 1
            continue

        chips[(chip_id, test_item, retest)] = {
            "value": value,
            "lower": lower,
            "upper": upper,
            "passed": lower <= value <= upper
        }

    passed_chips = 0
    failed_chip_ids = set()

    for chip_id, results in chips.items():
        chip_passed = all(result["passed"] for result in results.values())
        if chip_passed:
            passed_chips += 1
        else:
            failed_chip_ids.add(chip_id[0])

    yield_value = passed_chips / len(chips) if chips else 0.0

    return {
        "chips": len(chips),
        "passed_chips": passed_chips,
        "yield": yield_value,
        "failed_chip_ids": sorted(failed_chip_ids),
        "duplicates_ignored": duplicates_ignored,
        "missing_values": missing_values
    }
